text: {"rules":[{"id":"HIGH-BMI-PEDS-6PLUS-BEHAV","version":"June 2024","title":"High BMI in children and adolescents 6 years or older: provide or refer to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians provide or refer children and adolescents 6 years or older with a high body mass index (BMI) (≥95th percentile for age and sex) to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions.","grade":"B","effective_date":"June 2024","action":"Provide or refer children and adolescents 6 years or older with BMI at or above the 95th percentile for age and sex to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions.","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"age\":{\"min\":6,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"6 years or older\"},{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"bmi_percentile\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"latest\",\"value\":{\"op\":\">=\",\"threshold\":95,\"unit\":\"percentile\"}},\"quote\":\"≥95th percentile for age and sex\",\"note\":\"BMI percentile for age and sex, not raw BMI\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"text states no lookback period; latest measurement-year BMI percentile assumed\"}}]}","numerator":"{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"intensive_behavioral_weight_intervention\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions\",\"note\":\"Either provision of or referral to the intervention counts ('provide or refer')\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"text states no timeframe for providing or referring; measurement year assumed\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'bmi_percentile' (BMI percentile for age and sex) was used. The vocabulary concept 'bmi' is raw BMI, and 'obesity' includes overweight (the 85th percentile), so neither matches the ≥95th percentile threshold.","New concept 'intensive_behavioral_weight_intervention' (provision of or referral to a comprehensive, intensive behavioral intervention) was used. EHR data may not reliably show whether an intervention meets 'comprehensive, intensive' criteria such as contact hours; that requires human mapping.","No upper age limit is stated ('children and adolescents'), so none was encoded. A reviewer may want to cap the age at the end of adolescence.","The text gives no lookback window for the BMI measurement and no timeframe for the intervention or referral. Measurement-year windows were assumed and declared as derived.","The Practice Considerations section on behavioral interventions (content, intensity, contact hours) is referenced but not included, and was not represented.","The asterisk on the date ('June 2024 *') refers to a note not included in the section text."]}
